title: A LINE OVER THE GLASS
logSummary: A box kite rebuilt from a wreck, the Sonde cut loose, and a glide off T1 on the trade.

stages.note: Walk the line to the guild-house stud
stages.log: Walked the line from Benchmark 1 to the guild house.

stages.note: Talk to Ansel at the guild house
stages.log: Ansel brought down the kite off the beam.

stages.note: Cut sailcloth from the wreck on the black beach
stages.log: Cut sailcloth from the wreck on the beach.
Eight canes cut, four cords twisted.

stages.note: Rebuild the kite at the guild house
stages.log: Rebuilt the kite: two cells, new spars, new cloth.

stages.note: Cut the Sonde's tether at the Sounding Ring
stages.log: Cut the Sonde's tether. It drifted off downwind.

stages.note: Climb T1 and open the kite into the trade
stages.log: Opened the kite off the top of T1.

stages.note: Glide to the marked field below the Shelf
stages.log: Glided off T1 and landed on the marked field.

stages.note: Bring the kite back to Ansel
stages.log: Ansel said the kite is mine now.

closing.note: The Survey Kite is on your back
closing.logEnd: The Pan Houses have a kite again, and it's mine to fly.

scenes.where: the guild house, under the roof beam

lines: The pans' sighting kite went into
the surf off the black beach
in the last calima. Torn through.
Then the pans have no eye over
the Glass. Not past a hundred metres.
There's one more. Up on the beam.
Your mother's. Nesra left it there
when she went up to Mistfold.
Nine years on a beam.
The spars won't take a gust.
So rebuild it. Cane, cord, and
cloth off the wreck on the beach.
Eight canes and four cords.
And the sailcloth off the wreck.
And cut that Sonde loose at the Ring
before you fly. Moored there,
it calls every Plumb in the bay.
Off T1 on the trade, from 045.
Five metres on for every one down.
I watched you from the door.
Not one Plumb turned its lamp.
Fourteen metres of stair and four
of pillar, and I came down
on the mark. It flies true.
Then keep it. The guild has no one
else who'd hang under it.

breaAlone.about: Brea's own turns in the field on 'A Line Over the Glass': one card each, shown as a subtitle when its trigger first happens. Each trigger shows once.

lines: Benchmark 1 to the stud,
two hundred and eighty metres.
The wreck's ribs, three metres
of torn cloth still on them.
Salt-stiff, but it'll hold a seam.
Eight canes, straight enough.
Four cords twisted from the rush.
Two cells, cane spars, the bar
at my chest. It folds to a roll
under a metre long.
The Sonde, moored to the Ring.
One line to cut, from fifteen metres.
Cut. It's drifting off on 225,
downwind, lamp still on.
Top of T1. Wind on my face,
045, steady.
Down on the field. Walking pace
when my feet touched.
